reasons: Amber: CCC credit spread (OAS), Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance expensive, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) expensive

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.76% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +9bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (+1.3pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 15bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.1bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 147 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 99 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is expensive — you would be paying up for the tail. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 18.6 sits at the 68th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 8.9, so implied carries +9.7 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: SoftBank CDS near three-year high as OpenAI IPO delay exposes $20B funding gap
items.note: SoftBank's 5Y CDS jumped to ~385bps (highest since 2023) after Altman said an OpenAI IPO won't happen before 2027, leaving SoftBank without the listing proceeds it needs to refinance a $40B bridge loan backing its $64.6B OpenAI stake — a concrete refinancing/funding-gap risk in the OpenAI-SoftBank deal web.

items.headline: Oracle-led hyperscaler CDS spreads hit record wides as BofA survey names AI capex top systemic credit risk
items.note: 5Y CDS on a basket of Amazon/Google/Microsoft/Oracle broke above 100bps (Apollo's Slok says highest in his 8-year series) with Oracle's own CDS near record wides, while 42% of BofA's September fund-manager survey (up from 38% in August) now flags AI capex as the likeliest source of a systemic credit event — concrete, materially widening credit-market stress, not just equity chatter.

items.headline: Bernstein reiterates Sell on CoreWeave, warns an AI training slowdown would hit neoclouds hardest
items.note: Bernstein kept its Sell rating and $74 price target on CoreWeave, arguing that any pullback in frontier-model training (following Amodei/Altman's slowdown remarks) would disproportionately hurt GPU-debt-heavy neoclouds built around training workloads — a bearish analyst read on the most credit-levered segment of the AI buildout, not yet a realized event.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
